$comment: Spec §2. Adding or removing an axis must require no code change. `weight` is owner-supplied; the values below are PLACEHOLDER defaults — see OWNER-DATA.md item OD-01.

axes.label: Timelines
axes.question: When do systems capable of fully automating AI research arrive?

axes.label: Takeoff speed
axes.question: Once capable systems arrive, how fast does capability compound?

axes.label: P(misalignment)
axes.question: Do systems trained with roughly current methods end up pursuing goals their developers did not intend?

axes.label: P(scheming | misalignment)
axes.question: Given misaligned goals, does a system conceal them?

axes.label: P(containable | scheming)
axes.question: Given a scheming system at scale, can a well-resourced developer still catch and contain it?

axes.label: Harm origin
axes.question: Does the harm come from systems doing what nobody intended, or people doing exactly what they intended?

axes.label: Power risk locus
axes.question: Is the dangerous concentration of power between states or inside one?

axes.label: Binding constraint
axes.question: If AI goes badly, is it because we didn't know how, or because we knew and did it anyway?

axes.label: Working at frontier labs
axes.question: Does a safety researcher do more good inside a frontier lab or outside one?

axes.label: Scope of the goal
axes.question: Is avoiding catastrophe nearly sufficient, or does a good outcome need steering?

axes.label: AI moral patienthood
axes.question: Should whether AI systems are moral patients shape how the field allocates effort now?

axes.label: Assurance method
axes.question: Does assurance require understanding internal computation, or is behavioral testing enough?

axes.label: Architecture
axes.question: Patch the architectures we have, or design ones that are safe by construction?

axes.label: Automating alignment
axes.question: Will AI systems do a large share of alignment research before it matters?

axes.label: Policy venue
axes.question: Is a government position better than influencing from outside?

axes.label: Policy lever
axes.question: Should policy constrain what companies can do, or build the state's ability to evaluate?

axes.label: Partisan optionality
axes.question: Would you take a role that durably associates you with one party?
